capabilities: Render LaTeX code blocks to SVG
Detect and load required LaTeX packages
Adapt rendered output to dark mode
Clear cache and toggle live preview from the command palette
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX editor or export tool; it only renders LaTeX code blocks into SVG images inside notes.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.5.0+). Shell-escape is off by default and should be enabled only for trusted vaults, since it lets code blocks execute commands. Interface available in English and Italian.
intentEvidence: Supports any LaTeX package (pgfplots, circuitikz, tikz-cd, forest, nicematrix, algorithmicx, listings, ...), unlike TikZJax.
problem: LaTeX diagrams that need packages beyond what built-in math rendering or TikZJax can load cannot be shown inside Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: Supports any LaTeX package (pgfplots, circuitikz, tikz-cd, forest, nicematrix, algorithmicx, listings, ...), unlike TikZJax.

requires.name: TeX Live or MiKTeX with latex/pdflatex and dvisvgm

summary: Renders LaTeX code blocks such as TikZ diagrams, pgfplots, matrices, algorithms and math to SVG images using a local TeX installation.
